name: add_nurture_fields_to_leads_table
query: ALTER TABLE public.leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nurture_stage varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'; ALTER TABLE public.leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nurture_last_sent_at timestamptz NULL; ALTER TABLE public.leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nurture_next_at timestamptz NULL; ALTER TABLE public.leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS portal_status varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_invited'; ALTER TABLE public.leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS portal_invited_at timestamptz NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS leads_nurture_stage_index ON public.leads (nurture_stage); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS leads_nurture_next_at_index ON public.leads (nurture_next_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS leads_portal_status_index ON public.leads (portal_status); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.lead_nurture_events (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, lead_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.leads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, channel varchar(20) NOT NULL, step varchar(40) NOT NULL, status varchar(20) NOT NULL, provider_message_id varchar(255) NULL, payload jsonb NULL, sent_at timestamptz NULL, created_at timestamptz NULL, updated_at timestamptz NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lead_nurture_events_lead_id_created_at_index ON public.lead_nurture_events (lead_id, created_at);
